highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings and upgrades the bundled renderer to Chrome m152.
highlights_body: It adds asynchronous pixel reads, broadens Vulkan support, improves native lifetime safety, and updates platform packaging.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome m152 and includes subsequent upstream stability and servicing fixes.
Adds managed bindings for Skia's Graphite backend on Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.
Adds backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels APIs to SKImage and SKSurface.
Prevents use-after-free failures when extracting pixmap subsets or iterating region spans.

bullets.lead: Raster and HarfBuzz conversion failures release memory
bullets.detail: Fixes native pixel-buffer and stream-asset leaks on failure paths.
Disposes the previous uniform buffer when resetting SKRuntimeEffectUniforms.
Reduces avoidable allocations and lookup overhead in encoding, runtime effects, tag conversion, and HarfBuzz shaping.

bullets.lead: Vulkan Silk.NET and native symbol packages expanded
bullets.detail: Adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, restores its package production, and includes Apple native symbols in packs.

bullets.lead: Nano Server gains FreeType font support
bullets.detail: Uses FreeType to provide bundled font support on Nano Server.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font support for Nano Server
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel reads, the Chrome m152 engine update, and new Vulkan packaging.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 added servicing fixes, native package symbols, and runtime reliability improvements.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves HarfBuzz shaping performance and supporting managed helpers while aligning the bundled release with the 4.152 package line.

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Preview 1 introduces Graphite GPU bindings and the Chrome m152 renderer.
v4.152.0-preview.1.1.body: It also adds asynchronous pixel reads, Vulkan Silk.NET packaging, and Nano Server font support.

v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Release Candidate 1 adds servicing fixes and package improvements.
v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.body: It improves runtime reliability, native package symbols, and HarfBuzz shaping performance.

v4.152.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 ships Graphite GPU bindings on the Chrome m152 rendering engine.
v4.152.0.body: It includes asynchronous pixel reads, Vulkan package support, native lifetime fixes, and platform packaging improvements.
